summary: Our group, Team Hills, developed a webpage using Google Sites which educates younger students on the space junk left behind on the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space by NASA. Our page uses simpler terms in the form of bullet points so as to not look overwhelming or confuse students.
details: The intended impact of our project is to educate people/younger students about space junk left on the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space by NASA in simpler terms that are easier to understand. We used Google Sites to develop our webpage and our team considered using easier words + adding term definitions.
